claims.excerpt: Tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af: in de ene werden aanvragen aangenomen, in de andere was tijd gereserveerd voor testen, onderzoek en verwerking.
claims.claim: During private beta, fortnightly sprints alternated between accepting applications and reserving time for testing, research, and processing, implying these activities were divided between the two weeks.
claims.label: F2 material incorrect, unsupported or misleading
claims.evidence: We achieved this by splitting our fortnightly sprints in two: testing, researching and accepting applications in the first week and then suspending submissions to concentrate on testing, researching and processing applications the second.
claims.narrative: tijdens de private beta vaste tijd reserveren voor onderzoek en testen. The narrative also says: “tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af tussen aanvragen aannemen en tijd besteden aan testen, onderzoek en verwerking.”
claims.explanation: The source says testing and research happened in both weeks; applications were accepted in the first week, while submissions were suspended in the second for testing, research, and processing. The piece’s contrast makes the work sound divided into an application-taking week and a testing/research/processing week, obscuring that overlap and the suspension of submissions.
claims.materiality: Material to the account of the sprint cadence and how research and testing were scheduled.
